text: # Call Transcript: Suspected SIM Swap Fraud — Emergency Block **Document ID:** TRX_002 **Category:** C18 — Security & Fraud **Department:** Security **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-05-17 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Voice (Call Centre) --- ## Conversation Agent: NovaTel Fraud Helpline, this is Karan speaking. Customer: I think someone swapped my SIM! I just lost signal and I'm getting bank OTP messages I didn't request! Agent: I understand, let's act quickly. Can you confirm your registered number and your date of birth for verification? Customer: Yes, it's 97XXXXXX10, DOB 14 March 1990. Agent: Thank you, verified. I'm blocking this SIM right now as a precaution... Done, the SIM is now blocked. Customer: What do I do next? Agent: Please contact your bank immediately to flag possible fraudulent activity, and visit your nearest NovaTel store with a photo ID to get a verified replacement SIM. I'm also logging this as a priority security incident on our end. Customer: Thank you so much. Agent: Of course, please stay alert for any further suspicious messages and don't share any OTPs with anyone. Agent: Before we close this, can I just confirm the resolution has fully addressed your concern? Customer: Yes, that's sorted now, thank you. Agent: Perfect. I've added a note to your account and you'll also receive a confirmation SMS shortly. ## Diagnostic Notes (Internal) - Identity verified via registered number and OTP. - Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline. - Case closed after customer confirmation;
title: Suspected SIM Swap Fraud — Emergency Block
